context: Reconcile a synthetic payment ledger at the inclusive cutoff 2026-10-25. The complete register is in the input; no external data is needed. Amounts are integer cents and are not rounded. Each claim has an expected_cents. A payment adds its amount_cents and must have an empty reverses_id. A reversal fully cancels one payment event on the same claim, must name that payment's event_id, have the same amount_cents, and be posted on or after the payment; each payment can be reversed at most once, and reversals cannot be reversed. Identical rows with the same event_id are retransmissions: they count as one event and their event_id appears in duplicate_event_ids; reusing an event_id with different content invalidates the input. Events with posted_on <= as_of are included; events with posted_on > as_of are excluded. For each claim, included_event_ids and excluded_event_ids list the unique events in those groups; duplicate_event_ids lists the claim's event IDs that occur more than once as input rows, regardless of cutoff. paid_cents is included payment sum minus included reversal sum; balance_cents = expected_cents - paid_cents; status is balanced when balance_cents is 0, underpaid when positive, overpaid when negative. Output exactly one balance row per claim, including claims with no events; list orders are not significant.
